note.en: Native generation is verified with synthetic references; GUI playback and subjective quality are not covered by these checks.

note.en: An iPhone 17 Pro diagnostic verified reference-file generation, three WAV outputs and repeat equality. Microphone capture and normal-screen interaction are outside that diagnostic.
note.ja: iPhone 17 Proの診断で参照ファイル付き3生成・WAV保存・反復一致を確認。マイク録音と通常画面の操作は診断の対象外。

workload.en: Native implementation and CPU/build checks without model execution. The date is the record review date.
workload.ja: モデル実行を含まないネイティブ実装とCPU・ビルド検証。日付は記録の確認日。

workload.en: Native implementation and CPU/build checks without model execution. The date is the record review date.

ios-reference-v2.backend: Core AI; GPU preferred; audio/speaker/duration/decoder EFR false
ios-reference-v2.route: SpeechPhone explicit reference-file diagnostic; no playback or microphone capture
ios-reference-v2.code_revision: PR370 working tree based on a755889e87f027497d979d41e4469805b955faf6

workload.en: Synthetic 3.88-second reference; greeting, announcement, greeting; seed 1708; three WAVs and repeated greeting equality. This is not normal-screen or listening acceptance.
workload.ja: 合成音声3.88秒を参照し、挨拶→案内→挨拶をseed 1708で生成。WAV3本と挨拶の反復一致を確認。通常画面の操作・聴取受入とは区別する。

macos-release-v2.route: Native integration test; no latency benchmark; specialization cache not reset

workload.en: Reference and no-reference WAVs match fixed original-asset baselines byte-for-byte; repeated reference and 0.5/30-second reference boundaries pass. No microphone capture or GUI playback.
workload.ja: 参照あり・なしのWAVが固定した旧資産の出力とbyte一致。参照の反復と0.5/30秒の参照入力境界も成功。マイク録音・GUI再生は含まない。

macos-public-v2.variant: Reference voice FP32 v2 public release
macos-public-v2.route: Anonymous Models acquisition and nativeSmoke, with the historical M4/macOS 27.0 byte-equality check

workload.en: All 22 downloaded files pass size/SHA checks and become ready. Reference/no-reference generation, repeat equality and 0.5/30-second boundaries pass. The additional byte-equality gate against the earlier M4/macOS 27.0 WAVs fails; the same-host control is recorded separately.
workload.ja: 匿名取得22ファイルのサイズ・SHA照合とreadyを確認。参照あり/なし生成、反復一致、0.5/30秒境界は成功。追加した過去M4/macOS 27.0とのWAV byte一致ゲートは不合格。同じ実行機での対照は別に記録。

macos-public-v2.thermal: nominal (0) before and after released-asset generation

macos-public-v2-control.variant: Pre-strip reference FP32 v2 control against public release
macos-public-v2-control.route: Pre-strip assets vs public release on the same M5/macOS 27.2 host; identical generation code and dependencies

workload.en: Both pre-strip WAVs match the anonymous public-release outputs byte-for-byte on this host. Repeated-reference equality and 0.5/30-second reference boundaries pass. This does not make the historical cross-environment comparison pass. Thermal state was not sampled separately for this control.
workload.ja: 同じ実行機で旧資産のWAV2本が匿名取得した公開版とbyte一致。参照の反復と0.5/30秒の入力境界も成功。過去の別環境との比較は不合格のまま保持。 この対照のthermal stateは個別に採取していない。
